en: At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery. **The Training Rule on Making a Chugging Sound** At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks ate making a *capu-capu* sound... [etc.
"The training is to be observed: 'I shall not eat making a *capu-capu* sound.
One must not eat making a *capu-capu* sound.
Whoever, out of disrespect, eats making a *capucapu* sound, commits an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
the tenth training rule is concluded.
The fifth section, the Section on Mouthfuls, is finished.
